What happens if the other person drops out?

  • To limit waiting times during the two tasks, there is a time limit on every page. A timer will appear at the top of the screen when you only have 30 seconds left to proceed.
  • If you do not proceed in time you will be recorded as dropout and forwarded to the end of the survey and do not receive any payment.
  • If the other person drops out before he or she finishes the two tasks, you will continue until the end, and receive the full bonus of 2 GBP.

If you are ready, please click the "Next" button to begin the decisive round of Task 1.
